title: Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility — Prompt-Pay and Payment Arrangement Terms
content:
Two sets of patient terms on **Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility** accounts vary by payer class: the prompt-pay discount offered on a charge paid in full quickly, and the limits of a monthly payment arrangement.

## Prompt-pay terms

| Payer class | Prompt-pay discount (percent) | Prompt-pay window (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|
| Original Medicare Part B | 0 | 0 |
| Medicare Advantage HMO | 0 | 0 |
| Medicare Advantage PPO | 0 | 0 |
| Medicaid Fee-for-Service | 0 | 0 |
| Commercial HMO | 5 | 30 |
| Commercial PPO | 5 | 30 |
| Medicare Supplement Plan G | 0 | 0 |

The prompt-pay discount is the discount on a charge's patient responsibility when it is paid in full within the prompt-pay window; 0 means no prompt-pay discount for the class. The window is the calendar days after the first statement showing the charge within which payment in full earns the prompt-pay discount; it is 0 when there is no discount.

## Payment arrangement limits

| Payer class | Smallest balance for an arrangement (USD) | Smallest monthly installment (USD) | Longest arrangement (monthly installments) | Consecutive missed installments that default it |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Original Medicare Part B | 150.00 | 25.00 | 12 | 2 |
| Medicare Advantage HMO | 150.00 | 25.00 | 12 | 2 |
| Medicare Advantage PPO | 150.00 | 25.00 | 12 | 2 |
| Medicaid Fee-for-Service | 150.00 | 25.00 | 12 | 2 |
| Commercial HMO | 150.00 | 25.00 | 18 | 2 |
| Commercial PPO | 150.00 | 25.00 | 18 | 2 |
| Medicare Supplement Plan G | 150.00 | 25.00 | 12 | 2 |

- **Smallest balance**: the smallest account balance for which a monthly payment arrangement may be set.
- **Smallest monthly installment**: the smallest monthly installment accepted on a payment arrangement.
- **Longest arrangement**: the longest payment arrangement, in monthly installments (months).
- **Missed installments**: the consecutive missed installments after which an arrangement is defaulted.

## Reading the terms

Only the two commercial classes offer a prompt-pay discount (5 percent within 30 days) and allow an arrangement as long as 18 months; the five other classes show 0 for both prompt-pay columns and 12 months for the longest arrangement.
